outcome: Adverse fetal/neonatal events (death, preterm birth, small for gestational age)
cohort: The study included 1011 singleton pregnancies (>24 weeks) from the CARPREG database in patients with structural heart disease who underwent fetal/neonatal echocardiograms.
finding: Pregnancies with both maternal and fetal heart disease (MF-HD) were significantly more likely to experience adverse fetal/neonatal events and spontaneous preterm birth compared to those with maternal heart disease only (M-HD).
followup_time: Neonatal period (exact duration not specified, but covers birth to some point after)
